cold.label: Admission volume trend by month

cold.label: 30-day readmission rate by DRG severity (raw join)
cold.sql: SELECT d.drg_severity, count(*) n, round(avg(CAST(a.is_readmission_flag AS double)), 3) readmit FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_admission a JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.fact_drg_assignment d USING (hadm_id) WHERE d.drg_severity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cold.label: Abnormal-lab burden per admission type (raw join)
cold.sql: SELECT a.admission_type, count(*) labs, round(avg(CAST(l.is_abnormal_flag AS double)), 3) abn_rate FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_lab_result l JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.fact_admission a USING (hadm_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

cold.label: Abnormal vs normal lab counts (108k-row scan)
cold.sql: SELECT is_abnormal_flag, count(*) n FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_lab_result GROUP BY 1

cold.label: Medication-administration volume + reach (36k-row scan)
cold.sql: SELECT count(*) admins, count(DISTINCT hadm_id) admissions FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_medication_administration

cold.label: Positive blood-culture rate by month
cold.sql: SELECT chart_date_key / 100 AS ym, count(*) tests, round(avg(CAST(is_positive_culture_flag AS double)), 3) pos_rate FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_microbiology_result GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cold.label: Patient-360 cohort filter + rollup (pre-joined OBT)
cold.sql: SELECT gender, had_icu_stay, count(*) patients, round(avg(age_at_admission), 1) mean_age FROM mimic4_db_business_full.obt_admission_features GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cold.label: Readmission by DRG severity (via OBT -- compare to T2a)

cold.label: ICU stay features summary (pre-joined OBT)
cold.sql: SELECT first_careunit, count(*) stays, round(avg(los), 2) mean_los_days, round(avg(abnormal_chart_rate), 3) abn_chart FROM mimic4_db_business_full.obt_icu_stay_features GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cold.label: 30-day readmission by discharge-note tobacco_use (structured x NLP)
cold.sql: SELECT n.tobacco_use, count(*) admits, round(avg(CAST(a.is_readmission_flag AS double)), 3) readmit FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_discharge_note_nlp n JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.fact_admission a USING (subject_id, hadm_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cold.label: LOS by note-derived obesity_level (structured x NLP)
cold.sql: SELECT n.obesity_level, count(*) admits, round(avg(o.hospital_los_hours), 1) mean_los_hr FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_discharge_note_nlp n JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.obt_admission_features o USING (hadm_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cold.label: SDOH burden cross-tab (structured x NLP)
cold.sql: SELECT n.tobacco_use, n.alcohol_use, count(*) n FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_discharge_note_nlp n JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.fact_admission a USING (hadm_id) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

cold.label: Radiology-reported disorders, ranked (cross-modal JSON UNNEST)
cold.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar(dj, '$.text') disorder, json_extract_scalar(dj, '$.negated') negated, count(*) n FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_radiology_note_nlp r CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(json_parse(r.disorders) AS ARRAY(JSON))) AS t(dj) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

cold.label: Imaging modality mix per admission (cross-modal JSON x structured)
cold.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar(pj, '$.modality') modality, count(DISTINCT r.hadm_id) admits, count(*) exams FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_radiology_note_nlp r CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(json_parse(r.radiology_procedure_types) AS ARRAY(JSON))) AS t(pj) JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.fact_admission a ON a.hadm_id = r.hadm_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

cold.label: Radiology ICD codes vs coded diagnoses (cross-modal concordance)
cold.sql: SELECT json_extract_scalar(ij, '$.code') rad_code, count(DISTINCT r.hadm_id) rad_admits, count(DISTINCT fd.hadm_id) also_coded FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_radiology_note_nlp r CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(json_parse(r.icd_codes) AS ARRAY(JSON))) AS t(ij) LEFT JOIN mimic4_db_business_full.fact_diagnosis fd ON fd.hadm_id = r.hadm_id AND fd.icd_code = replace(json_extract_scalar(ij, '$.code'), '.', '') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

cold.label: Chart-observation volume + reach (669k-row scan)
cold.sql: SELECT count(*) rows, count(DISTINCT hadm_id) admissions, count(DISTINCT subject_id) patients FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_chart_observation

cold.label: Charted-value abnormality rate by month (669k-row scan + group)
cold.sql: SELECT chart_date_key / 100 AS ym, count(*) obs, round(avg(CAST(is_abnormal_flag AS double)), 3) abn_rate FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_chart_observation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cold.label: Instability proxy: non-null numeric vitals per ICU stay (669k-row scan)
cold.sql: SELECT stay_id, count(*) numeric_obs FROM mimic4_db_business_full.fact_chart_observation WHERE value_num IS NOT NULL AND stay_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25
